steps.message: `client.py` is shared: `scripts/export_prod.py` imports the same functions against `https://reports.example.com`. An unconditional `verify=False` there would silently disable certificate validation for the production export too, not just staging. So I made it opt-out per environment and turned it off only in the staging script — staging works the same, prod stays verified.
